scripts.dev: pnpm --filter shared build && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "web,api" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api dev"
scripts.bundle:api: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api bundle && node scripts/prepare-deploy-api.js
scripts.build:demo: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web exec ng build --configuration demo
